modmenu.descriptionTranslation.skyblockm: Creates an empty world with a HUB and individual islands. Configure island distance and allowed tree types in Mod Menu.
skyblockmulti.welcome: Welcome. When the menu appears, choose a tree to claim your island.
skyblockmulti.menu.title: === CLAIM YOUR SKYBLOCK ISLAND ===
skyblockmulti.menu.instruction: Choose one of the tree types enabled by the administrator.
skyblockmulti.menu.footer: All available trees produce saplings or propagules that can be replanted.
skyblockmulti.menu.not_ready: The island anchors are still being prepared. The menu will reappear automatically.
skyblockmulti.menu.server_full: There are no free islands among the 24 available positions.
skyblockmulti.menu.tree_disabled: That tree is disabled in the configuration. Choose another option.
skyblockmulti.config.title: SkyblockMulti
skyblockmulti.config.distance.label: Island distance, in blocks
skyblockmulti.config.tree_note: Includes every vanilla tree that uses a sapling or propagule.
skyblockmulti.config.multi_saplings: Dark oak and pale oak require 4 saplings to grow again.
skyblockmulti.config.capacity_note: Distance changes spacing; maximum capacity remains 24.
skyblockmulti.config.status.saved: Saved and applied to future islands.
skyblockmulti.config.status.save_failed: The configuration file could not be saved.
skyblockmulti.menu.tree.random.hover: Randomly chooses one of the enabled trees
skyblockmulti.menu.random_note: Random only selects enabled tree types.
skyblockmulti.config.bonus_chest.note: Defines the easiest option available for new islands.
skyblockmulti.respawn.fallback: Your respawn point was obstructed; slow falling was used above your island.
skyblockmulti.respawn.cleared: The point was blocked. Only the two blocks above the bedrock were cleared and you were returned to your island.
skyblockmulti.respawn.bed_respected: Your bed or respawn anchor was respected.
skyblockmulti.difficulty.title: === CHOOSE YOUR ISLAND DIFFICULTY ===
skyblockmulti.difficulty.instruction: Choose the starter resources for your island.
skyblockmulti.difficulty.extreme.hover: No starter chest. Recommended for experienced players.
skyblockmulti.difficulty.hard.hover: Water bucket and lava bucket only.
skyblockmulti.difficulty.easy.hover: Standard resources plus seeds, food, and a bed.
skyblockmulti.difficulty.note: This choice only affects your own newly generated island.
skyblockmulti.difficulty.blocked: That difficulty is blocked by the world configuration.
